editorial:
Chris and his girlfriend Rose head upstate to meet her parents for the weekend. At first, everything seems like a normal awkward family visit. But the parents and their friends act way too friendly and strange around Chris. You can feel the tension building as small moments start to feel off. The movie mixes real-world discomfort with genuine scares, making you question what is really going on.

The acting is fantastic, especially Daniel Kaluuya, who carries the whole film with his expressions. The pacing keeps you on edge without rushing. The only downside is some scenes might feel slow if you want nonstop action. If you enjoy smart thrillers with a message, this is for you. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: Chris discovers Rose's family kidnaps Black people and transfers older white people's minds into their bodies. Rose was in on it the whole time. Chris fights back, kills several family members, and escapes. Rose tries to stop him but he leaves her behind. He gets away just as police arrive, and his friend Rod saves him. The twist reveals the whole weekend was a trap.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves smart thrillers with social commentary
